>
[Compound Eyes](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3181)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fortune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=612" />
<trait label="Graft" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=790" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 98

**Price** 75 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** implanted

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

You replace your eyes with ones similar to an insect’s or a crustacean’s, which allow you to better pinpoint movement. Once per day when you attempt a flat check to target a creature that’s [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) from you, you can roll twice and take the better result.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
